name: Banqi: 1 engine games
description: MistyBanqi against itself at ten million nodes a move, three times the strength the site's bot plays at, under the Taiwanese competition rules the site uses. 1 decisive, 0 drawn. Each chapter opens into its own deal; the note on each says what the replay shows.

games.name: Game 1: second seat wins in 34
games.intro: MistyBanqi against itself at 10 million nodes a move, three times the strength the site's bot plays at. The first flip turned up red, so the first seat played red. 34 moves, 32 flips, 20 captures, the first at move 5. Biggest capture: red general taken at move 32. The second seat (black) won: Red was left with no move; the winner led on material from move 5 and never gave it back.
games.event: Banqi, engine games under the competition rules
